intro: Utopia bed gives you a quiet kind of power—solid wood, spacious storage, and soft support that helps you lie back, stretch out, and stay grounded.

features.title: We bring calm to your core
features.text: Utopia is carved from solid sheesham, a wood that resists wear and holds presence, night after night.

features.title: Storage that opens with ease
features.text: Access storage with ease. The thoughtfully designed hydraulic storage allows hassle-free organisation without the need to remove the mattress.

features.title: Our headboard holds you gently
features.text: The PVC-cushioned headboard offers soft support for reading, scrolling, or just sinking in.

features.title: Timeless charm with elegant design
features.text: Every grain in the natural finish speaks of timeless craft—and a piece that grows with your life.

features.title: Designed to stay for decades
features.text: Built from sheesham wood, the bed is resistant to wear and insects, ensuring a long-lasting and worry-free addition to your home.

name: Utopia King Size Solid Wood Bed With Upholstered Headboard And Hydraulic Storage
